packs.topic: Gemini 3.7 Flash: где он опережает Claude Sonnet 5 и сколько стоит
packs.summary: Узкое и воспроизводимое сравнение: только опубликованные разработчиками цены и конкретные метрики из model card, без заявления о безусловном превосходстве одной модели.

sources.title: Introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash
sources.excerpt: Google announced Gemini 3.7 Flash on August 13, 2026, describing it as a workhorse for coding and agents with introductory $0.75 input and $3.75 output pricing per million tokens through year-end.

sources.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash Model Card
sources.excerpt: Google's August 2026 model card lists a benchmark table comparing Gemini 3.7 Flash, Gemini 3.6 Flash, Claude Sonnet 5 and other models, together with stated token prices.

sources.title: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5
sources.excerpt: Anthropic states that Claude Sonnet 5 is available at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens; its August 10 update says that this pricing is permanent.

claims.statement: Google released Gemini 3.7 Flash on 13 August 2026 with introductory pricing of $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens through 31 December 2026.

In Google's published model-card table, Gemini 3.7 Flash scores above Claude Sonnet 5 on FrontierCode 1.1 Main (43.6% versus 42.7%) and Code Arena Web Development (1588 versus 1541); this is not a claim of universal superiority.
At the published API list prices, Gemini 3.7 Flash costs 62.5% less per input token and 62.5% less per output token than Claude Sonnet 5 ($0.75/$3.75 versus $2/$10 per million).

packs.topic: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813: GA-релиз, agent upgrades и гибкое reasoning
packs.summary: Свежий DeepSeek-релиз с фактами о доступе, reason-effort и API. Сценарий не обещает, что большая модель автоматически дешева или пригодна для локального запуска.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro GA Release
sources.excerpt: DeepSeek announces V4 Pro GA, flexible reasoning effort for V4 Pro and V4 Flash, native OpenAI Responses API support, availability in Expert Mode and through the API.

sources.title: DeepSeek Models and Pricing
sources.excerpt: DeepSeek lists DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, thinking and non-thinking modes, 1M context, 384K maximum output, tool calls and current token prices, plus an announced peak and off-peak schedule.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 Model Card
sources.excerpt: The official DeepSeek model card identifies V4-Pro-0813 as the release superseding preview, documents agentic improvements, and describes low, high and max reasoning-effort controls.

claims.statement: DeepSeek announced V4 Pro GA on 13 August 2026; it is available on app/web through Expert Mode and via the API.
DeepSeek documents low, high and max reasoning-effort levels for V4 Pro, allowing effort to be selected by task complexity rather than always using the maximum setting.
The DeepSeek pricing documentation lists V4-Pro-0813 with 1M context, a 384K maximum output, JSON output, tool calls, Responses API and Anthropic API support.

packs.topic: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813: как читать текущие и новые peak/off-peak цены
packs.summary: Цена привязана к конкретной версии и дате вступления тарифов. Ролик разделяет текущий прайс и запланированные peak/off-peak ставки, не выдавая будущие цены за действующие сегодня.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro GA Release and API Pricing Update
sources.excerpt: DeepSeek says V4 API pricing will change to peak and off-peak rates on 16 August 2026, with off-peak rates 50% lower than peak rates.

sources.title: DeepSeek Models and Pricing
sources.excerpt: The official pricing table gives current V4 Pro cache-hit, cache-miss and output prices, then separately lists the peak and off-peak prices that take effect on 16 August 2026.

claims.statement: Before the announced 16 August change, DeepSeek lists V4 Pro at $0.003625 per million cache-hit input tokens, $0.435 per million cache-miss input tokens and $0.87 per million output tokens.

DeepSeek says the new V4 peak/off-peak rates take effect at 16:00 UTC on 16 August 2026; for V4 Pro, the listed off-peak rates are $0.022 cache-hit input, $0.66 cache-miss input and $1.98 output per million tokens.
The announced off-peak prices are future rates on 14 August 2026, so a cost estimate must label them as effective from 16 August rather than present them as today's invoice.

packs.topic: Grok 4.6: новый long-running agent, API и cache-aware цена
packs.summary: Актуальный xAI-релиз с чётким разделением между consumer plan, API и кэшированным input. Никаких обещаний безлимита в free access.

sources.title: Introducing Grok 4.6
sources.excerpt: xAI announced Grok 4.6 on August 12, 2026, focused on long-running agents and interactive/visual work, with availability in Cursor, Grok Build, API and partners.

sources.title: Grok 4.6 Developer Model Documentation
sources.excerpt: xAI documents Grok 4.6 with text and image input, 500K context, function calling, structured outputs, reasoning, and list prices for standard and cached input tokens.

sources.title: xAI Pricing
sources.excerpt: xAI lists a Free consumer plan with limited access and lists Grok 4.6 under paid SuperGrok access; the public plan page does not present an unlimited-free-use claim.

claims.statement: xAI released Grok 4.6 on 12 August 2026 with a stated focus on long-running agents, interactive work and visual projects.
The xAI model documentation lists Grok 4.6 with a 500K context window, function calling, structured outputs and reasoning capabilities.
xAI lists Grok 4.6 API pricing at $2 per million input tokens, $0.50 per million cached input tokens and $6 per million output tokens.

packs.topic: Свежая cost map: Gemini 3.7 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813, Grok 4.6 и Claude Sonnet 5
packs.summary: Сравнение API-list prices на одну дату и одну единицу измерения. Ролик подчёркивает, что benchmark, cache hit, output mix и условия доступа меняют финальную стоимость.

sources.title: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform Pricing
sources.excerpt: Google Cloud lists Gemini 3.7 Flash introductory pricing at $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million text output tokens through December 31, 2026.

sources.title: DeepSeek Models and Pricing
sources.excerpt: DeepSeek's current V4 Pro table lists $0.435 cache-miss input and $0.87 output per million tokens before its announced August 16 pricing schedule takes effect.

sources.title: Grok 4.6 Developer Model Documentation
sources.excerpt: xAI lists Grok 4.6 standard API price as $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens, with cached input at $0.50 per million tokens.

sources.title: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5
sources.excerpt: Anthropic says Claude Sonnet 5 is priced at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, and its August 10 update says the introductory price is permanent.

claims.statement: For the published standard/list input prices captured on 14 August 2026, Gemini 3.7 Flash is $0.75, DeepSeek V4 Pro is $0.435 cache-miss, Grok 4.6 is $2 and Claude Sonnet 5 is $2 per million input tokens.
For the published standard/list output prices captured on 14 August 2026, Gemini 3.7 Flash is $3.75, DeepSeek V4 Pro is $0.87, Grok 4.6 is $6 and Claude Sonnet 5 is $10 per million output tokens.

Token list price alone is not a quality ranking: providers publish different cache prices, context conditions, effort controls and benchmark methodologies, so a production choice needs a task-specific test.
